purpose: Correct named native method arguments initialize, deliver and inject the supplied Throwable through the ordinary Generator protocol.
source:
<?php
class Stop109A extends Exception {}
function Flow109A() {
    global $stop;
    echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'GOT|', $value, '|';
    try { yield 'tail'; }
    catch (Stop109A $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|'; yield 'caught'; }
    return 109;
}
$stop = new Stop109A(); $generator = Flow109A();
echo 'SEND|', $generator->send(value: 41), '|';
echo 'THROW|', $generator->throw(exception: $stop), '|';
$generator->next(); echo 'RETURN|', $generator->getReturn(), '|', $generator->valid() === false, '|';

purpose: The first ARRAY pack snapshots a mutable nested ARRAY before a later pack producer clears the source pack and mutates the caller ARRAY; empty packs also admit zero-argument methods.
source:
<?php
function Later109B() {
    global $pack, $payload;
    echo 'LATER|'; $pack = null; $payload[0] = 99; return [];
}
function Flow109B() {
    global $payload;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head';
        echo 'GOT|', $value[0] === 21, '|', $payload[0] === 99, '|';
        yield 'tail';
    } finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
}
$payload = []; $payload[] = 21; $pack = ['value' => $payload];
$generator = Flow109B();
echo 'CURRENT|', $generator->current(...[]), '|';
echo 'SEND|', $generator->send(...$pack, ...Later109B()), '|', $pack === null, '|';
unset($generator); echo 'DONE|';
